verdict.rationale: The evidence shows built-in automations: JAX auto-categorizing and matching transactions, automatic duplicate-bill flagging, and AI-drafted bills from forwarded emails. None of these documents user-definable rules or event-triggered actions; they are fixed vendor behaviors, which count only as adjacent features. The API, SDK and MCP server are developer building blocks, not a rules engine.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
